request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:GUARD

layers.text: Add only one thing: a short dark gunmetal mast behind his left shoulder that holds one small round silver dish emitter with a glowing hot magenta centre beside the top left of his helmet. Do not redraw anything else: keep the big round chrome shield with its magenta lens and rim, his head, eyes, helmet, antenna, shoulder plates, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
